voiceover_script.hook: Stop choosing the wrong editor in 2026! Here is the honest developer verdict on Visual Studio Code.
voiceover_script.pricing_segment: Pricing breakdown: Free (Open Source / MIT Core). Free / Optional Paid AI Plugins.
voiceover_script.pros_segment: Why developers love it: Massive extension marketplace with thousands of extensions, Extremely fast startup and responsive typing latency, Native Git integration and multi-language support out of the box, Robust remote development capabilities (SSH, Containers, WSL).
voiceover_script.cons_segment: What you need to watch out for: High RAM consumption with heavily stacked plugins, Requires configuration tuning for complex project setups.
voiceover_script.recommendation_callout: Final Recommendation: The best overall free editor for web, cloud, and multi-language developers.
